name: Scapular Pullup
description: Raise the body a small distance from a hang using the shoulder blades while keeping the elbows straight.

items.content: Start from a comfortable straight-arm hang on a secure bar, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Draw the shoulder blades down to lift the chest and body slightly.
Keep elbows straight; avoid kicking, swinging, or flaring the ribs.
Let the shoulders rise again slowly; use foot support to reduce the load if needed.

stages.name: Hang
stages.description: Body hanging vertically from an overhead bar, arms straight and shoulders raised near the ears. Legs hang together.

stages.name: Active hang
stages.description: Body slightly higher beneath the same bar, arms still straight and shoulders farther from the ears. Chest is slightly lifted without bending the elbows or arching the lower back.
